records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2025 increased by 6% to $844.6 million compared to $794.1 million for the same period in 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Notwithstanding these considerations, utility and corporate demand for clean energy, and overall electric load growth, especially as a result of artificial intelligence-driven data center demand, continue to increase.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase was primarily driven by an 8.0% increase in the volume of modules sold to third parties.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In recent years, the cost of producing electricity from PV solar power systems has decreased to levels that are competitive with or below the wholesale price of electricity in many markets.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by lower cash receipts from module sales, lower proceeds from the sale of Section 45X tax credits, and an increase in payments made to suppliers compared to the prior period.
